newsitem.title: USA: Tracor unit wins $126 mln, 3-yr contract.
newsitem.headline: Tracor unit wins $126 mln, 3-yr contract.

text.p: Vitro Services Corp, a subsidiary of Tracor Inc, said it has been given a $126 million three-year basic contract from the U.S. Air Force development test center, Eglin Air Force Base, in Florida.
The company said its contract is for three years, with a follow-up option of two years, followed by another option for three additional years.
The company said the total potential of the contract is $342 million, and contract support will be provided through September 2005.
